agent.problem: The card retells Jesus driving out the sellers, which comes from Luke 19:45, as well as His declaration in Luke 19:46. Its citation covers only Luke 19:46, so it is narrower than the verses the card uses.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

agent.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences: the background on John, Jesus' question with its accompanying comment, and "How hard could it be?" It needs to be reduced to one or two sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: Seven of the ten choice cards are multiple choice, including the first five choices in a row. With only two true-or-false cards and one fill-in-the-blank card, multiple choice dominates the stop by a wide margin.

rule.text: No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.
